tools.name: trackView_functions_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of the TrackView class from the Live Object Model API documentation.

trackView.description: object ID or canonical path of the track view

summary.description: Representing the view aspects of a track. Canonical path: live_set tracks N view

tools.name: trackView_children_get_selectedDevice
tools.description: Get the selected device or the first selected device in case of multi/group selection.

trackView.description: object ID or canonical path of the track view

selectedDevice.description: selected device ID or first selected device ID

tools.name: trackView_properties_get_deviceInsertMode
tools.description: Get where a device will be inserted when loaded from the browser.

trackView.description: object ID or canonical path of the track view

deviceInsertMode.description: device insert mode (0 = add at end, 1 = add left of selected, 2 = add right of selected)

tools.name: trackView_properties_get_isCollapsed
tools.description: Get whether the track is collapsed in Arrangement View.

trackView.description: object ID or canonical path of the track view

isCollapsed.description: whether track is collapsed in Arrangement View (1 = collapsed, 0 = opened)

tools.name: trackView_properties_set_deviceInsertMode
tools.description: Set where a device will be inserted when loaded from the browser.

trackView.description: object ID or canonical path of the track view

deviceInsertMode.description: device insert mode (0 = add at end, 1 = add left of selected, 2 = add right of selected)

success.description: whether device insert mode was set successfully

tools.name: trackView_properties_set_isCollapsed
tools.description: Set whether the track is collapsed in Arrangement View.

trackView.description: object ID or canonical path of the track view

isCollapsed.description: whether track should be collapsed in Arrangement View (1 = collapsed, 0 = opened)

success.description: whether collapsed state was set successfully

tools.name: trackView_functions_selectInstrument
tools.description: Select track's instrument or first device, make it visible and focus on it.

trackView.description: object ID or canonical path of the track view

success.description: whether instrument selection was successful (false if there are no devices to select)
